name: Goblet squat
instructions: Hold one dumbbell vertically at your chest, elbows down.
Sit down between your knees with your chest up until thighs reach parallel or as deep as comfortable.
Drive through the whole foot to stand.

name: Back squat
instructions: Set the bar on your upper back and unrack with feet about shoulder width.
Brace, then sit down and slightly back until hips reach knee height or below.
Drive up, keeping the bar over mid-foot.
safety_notes: Use safety pins set just below your bottom position.

name: Front squat
instructions: Rack the bar on the front of your shoulders, elbows high.
Squat straight down keeping the torso upright.
Stand up without letting the elbows drop.

name: Box squat
instructions: Stand in front of a box at knee height.
Sit back until you lightly touch the box, without relaxing.
Stand up by driving through the heels.

name: Bodyweight squat
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder width, arms forward for balance.
Squat as deep as you can with heels down.
Stand up and squeeze the glutes.

name: Bulgarian split squat
instructions: Place the rear foot on a bench, front foot about a stride ahead.
Lower straight down until the rear knee nearly touches the floor.
Push through the front foot to rise; finish all reps, then switch legs.

name: Reverse lunge
instructions: Step one foot back and lower until both knees are about 90 degrees.
Push through the front foot to return.
Alternate legs or finish one side first.

name: Walking lunge
instructions: Step forward into a lunge, back knee close to the floor.
Drive up and step the back foot through into the next lunge.
Keep the torso tall.

name: Step-up
instructions: Place one foot fully on a knee-height box.
Drive through that foot to stand on the box without pushing off the back leg.
Lower under control.

name: Lateral lunge
instructions: Step wide to one side, sitting back into that hip with the other leg straight.
Push back to the start.
Alternate sides.

name: Leg press
instructions: Feet shoulder width on the platform.
Lower until knees reach about 90 degrees without the lower back lifting.
Press up without locking the knees hard.

name: Leg extension
instructions: Align your knee with the machine pivot.
Extend the legs fully, pause briefly.
Lower under control.

name: Wall sit
instructions: Slide down a wall until thighs are parallel to the floor.
Hold for time, breathing steadily.

name: Romanian deadlift
instructions: Stand holding the weight at your thighs, knees slightly bent.
Push the hips back and slide the weight down your legs until you feel a strong hamstring stretch.
Drive the hips forward to stand, keeping the back flat.
safety_notes: Stop the descent before your lower back rounds.

name: Deadlift
instructions: Bar over mid-foot, grip just outside the legs.
Brace, flatten the back and push the floor away.
Lock out with hips and knees together, then lower under control.
safety_notes: Keep the bar close; stop the set if your back rounds.

name: Trap bar deadlift
instructions: Stand in the centre of the bar and grip the handles.
Brace and stand up by pushing the floor away.
Lower with control.

name: Single-leg Romanian deadlift
instructions: Hold a weight in the hand opposite the standing leg.
Hinge forward as the free leg extends behind you, hips square.
Return to standing.

name: Kettlebell swing
instructions: Hike the bell back between your legs with a flat back.
Snap the hips forward to float the bell to chest height.
Let it fall back and repeat.
safety_notes: The power comes from the hips, not the arms.

name: Hip thrust
instructions: Upper back on a bench, weight across the hips.
Drive the hips up until the torso is level, chin tucked.
Lower under control.

name: Glute bridge
instructions: Lie on your back, knees bent, feet flat.
Drive the hips up and squeeze the glutes.
Lower slowly.

name: Good morning
instructions: Bar on the upper back, knees soft.
Hinge at the hips until the torso is near parallel.
Return to standing.
safety_notes: Use light loads; stop before the back rounds.

name: Back extension
instructions: Hips on the pad, body straight.
Lower the torso by hinging at the hips.
Raise back to a straight line without overextending.

name: Lying leg curl
instructions: Lie face down with the pad above your heels.
Curl the heels toward the glutes.
Lower slowly.

name: Nordic hamstring curl
instructions: Kneel with ankles anchored.
Lower the torso forward as slowly as possible, body straight.
Catch yourself with the hands and push back up.
safety_notes: Start with a short range; very demanding on the hamstrings.

name: Dumbbell floor press
instructions: Lie on the floor, knees bent, dumbbells over the chest.
Lower until the upper arms touch the floor.
Press back up.

name: Bench press
instructions: Eyes under the bar, shoulder blades pulled back.
Lower the bar to the lower chest.
Press up and slightly back.
safety_notes: Use safety arms or a spotter.

name: Dumbbell bench press
instructions: Lie on a bench with dumbbells over the chest.
Lower until elbows are slightly below the bench.
Press up.

name: Incline dumbbell press
instructions: Set the bench to about 30 degrees.
Lower the dumbbells to the upper chest.
Press up.

name: Push-up
instructions: Hands slightly wider than shoulders, body in a straight line.
Lower the chest to just above the floor.
Push back up.

name: Incline push-up
instructions: Hands on a bench, body straight.
Lower the chest to the bench.
Push back up.

name: Dip
instructions: Support yourself on the bars, arms straight.
Lower until the shoulders are slightly below the elbows.
Press back up.
safety_notes: Skip if dips cause shoulder pain.

name: Cable chest fly
instructions: Stand between the pulleys with a slight forward lean.
Bring the handles together in an arc, elbows slightly bent.
Return slowly.

name: Overhead press
instructions: Bar on the front of the shoulders, grip just outside them.
Brace and press the bar straight overhead, moving the head out of the way.
Lower to the shoulders.

name: Dumbbell shoulder press
instructions: Dumbbells at shoulder height, palms forward.
Press overhead.
Lower under control.

name: Half-kneeling landmine press
instructions: Kneel on one knee, holding the bar end at the shoulder on the same side as the down knee.
Press up and forward.
Lower under control; switch sides.

name: Lateral raise
instructions: Hold dumbbells at your sides.
Raise them out to shoulder height, elbows slightly bent.
Lower slowly.

name: Pike push-up
instructions: Hips high, hands and feet on the floor.
Lower the head toward the floor between the hands.
Press back up.

name: Single-arm dumbbell row
instructions: Support one hand and knee on a bench.
Pull the dumbbell toward the hip.
Lower until the arm is straight.

name: Barbell row
instructions: Hinge to about 45 degrees with a flat back.
Pull the bar to the lower ribs.
Lower under control.

name: Chest-supported dumbbell row
instructions: Lie face down on an incline bench.
Row the dumbbells to the sides of the ribs.
Lower slowly.

name: Seated cable row
instructions: Sit tall, feet braced.
Pull the handle to the stomach, squeezing the shoulder blades together.
Return with control.

name: Inverted row
instructions: Hang under a bar or rings with the body straight.
Pull the chest up to the hands.
Lower slowly.

name: Pull-up
instructions: Hang with an overhand grip, slightly wider than shoulders.
Pull until the chin clears the bar.
Lower to straight arms.

name: Chin-up
instructions: Hang with an underhand grip, shoulder width.
Pull until the chin clears the bar.
Lower to straight arms.

name: Band-assisted pull-up
instructions: Loop a band over the bar and place a knee or foot in it.
Pull up until the chin clears the bar.
Lower slowly.

name: Lat pulldown
instructions: Grip slightly wider than shoulders, thighs under the pad.
Pull the bar to the upper chest.
Return with control.

name: Face pull
instructions: Rope at face height.
Pull toward the face, hands finishing beside the ears.
Return slowly.
safety_notes: Good for shoulder health; use light loads.

name: Band pull-apart
instructions: Hold a band at shoulder height, arms straight.
Pull it apart until it touches the chest.
Return slowly.

name: Dumbbell shrug
instructions: Hold dumbbells at your sides.
Lift the shoulders toward the ears.
Lower slowly.

name: Dumbbell biceps curl
instructions: Hold dumbbells at your sides, palms forward.
Curl up without swinging.
Lower slowly.

name: Hammer curl
instructions: Hold dumbbells with palms facing each other.
Curl up.
Lower slowly.

name: Triceps pushdown
instructions: Elbows at your sides.
Push the bar or rope down until the arms are straight.
Return without moving the elbows.

name: Overhead triceps extension
instructions: Hold one dumbbell overhead with both hands.
Lower it behind the head.
Extend the arms.

name: Skull crusher
instructions: Lie on a bench, weight above the shoulders.
Bend the elbows to lower the weight toward the forehead.
Extend back up.

name: Standing calf raise
instructions: Balls of the feet on a step.
Rise as high as possible.
Lower the heels below the step.

name: Seated calf raise
instructions: Sit with weight on the knees, balls of the feet raised.
Lift the heels.
Lower fully.

name: Dead bug
instructions: Lie on your back, arms up and knees over hips.
Lower the opposite arm and leg while pressing the lower back into the floor.
Return and switch sides.

name: Plank
instructions: Forearms on the floor, body in a straight line.
Squeeze the glutes and brace.
Hold for time.

name: Side plank
instructions: Lie on one side, forearm under the shoulder.
Lift the hips into a straight line.
Hold, then switch sides.

name: Bird dog
instructions: On hands and knees.
Extend the opposite arm and leg without rotating the hips.
Return and switch sides.

name: Pallof press
instructions: Stand side-on to the anchor, handle at the chest.
Press straight out and resist the rotation.
Return; finish one side, then switch.

name: Hanging knee raise
instructions: Hang from a bar.
Raise the knees toward the chest without swinging.
Lower slowly.

name: Ab wheel rollout
instructions: Kneel holding the wheel.
Roll forward as far as you can keep the back flat.
Pull back to the start.

name: Russian twist
instructions: Sit with feet off the floor, torso leaning back.
Rotate side to side.
Keep the chest up.

name: Hollow body hold
instructions: Lie on your back, arms overhead.
Lift shoulders and legs, lower back pressed down.
Hold for time.

name: Copenhagen plank
instructions: Side plank with the top leg on a bench and the bottom leg free.
Lift the hips into a straight line.
Hold, then switch sides.
safety_notes: Useful for skaters' groin strength; start with the knee on the bench.

name: Suitcase carry
instructions: Hold one heavy weight at your side.
Walk tall without leaning.
Switch hands each length.

name: Farmer's carry
instructions: Hold a heavy weight in each hand.
Walk tall with short, quick steps.
Set down with a flat back.

name: Box jump
instructions: Stand in front of a low box.
Swing the arms and jump up, landing softly.
Step down.
safety_notes: Choose a low box; step down rather than jumping down.

name: Lateral bound
instructions: Jump sideways off one leg.
Land softly on the other leg and stick the landing.
Bound back.

name: Medicine ball slam
instructions: Lift the ball overhead.
Slam it into the floor as hard as you can.
Pick it up and repeat.

name: Medicine ball rotational throw
instructions: Stand side-on to a wall.
Rotate and throw the ball into the wall from the hip.
Catch and repeat; switch sides.

name: Burpee
instructions: Squat down and place the hands on the floor.
Jump the feet back, then forward.
Jump up.

name: Jump rope
instructions: Turn the rope from the wrists.
Make small, quick jumps on the balls of the feet.
Work for time.

name: Rowing machine
instructions: Push with the legs first, then lean back and pull with the arms.
Return in reverse order.
Work for time or distance.

name: Stationary bike
instructions: Set the saddle so the knee is slightly bent at the bottom.
Ride for time or intervals.

name: Kettlebell goblet carry
instructions: Hold a kettlebell at the chest by the horns.
Walk tall for distance.

name: World's greatest stretch
instructions: Step into a long lunge and place both hands inside the front foot.
Rotate and reach the inside arm to the ceiling.
Return and switch sides.

name: Cat-cow
instructions: On hands and knees.
Alternate rounding and arching the spine slowly.

name: 90/90 hip switch
instructions: Sit with both knees bent at 90 degrees to one side.
Rotate the knees to the other side without using the hands if you can.
Move slowly.

name: Couch stretch
instructions: Kneel with the back foot up against a wall or couch.
Squeeze the glute and lift the chest.
Hold, then switch sides.
safety_notes: Useful for hip flexors tightened by skating.
